34.nps_why: 很好的觀賞體驗，可以欣賞舞蹈的多元、力量。與演奏配合得很好。__LINEBREAK____LINEBREAK__
34.comment: 特別欣賞配樂細緻，例如在《我城》的配樂聽到噪鵑、麻雀等香港常見雀鳥的叫聲。

35.nps_why: The dance truly expressed a beautiful painting through simplicity and seamlessly graceful movements.

36.nps_why: 我會向朋友推薦看這個演出，音樂、中國水墨畫和舞蹈所結合的演出藝術很精彩。音樂動聽有感染力，舞蹈編排結合視像設計配合得很有詩意。
36.comment: 視、聽覺藝術配合得很精彩，很享受這次表演。

37.nps_why: 題材意想不到，編舞有創意也很符合吳冠中的作品，但舞者之間的協調尤其節奏方面略嫌不足，雖然部分獨舞者可看出功底深厚。

40.nps_why: The performing time is a bit short, not too worth!

41.comment: 結尾的彩球畫面很美，只是有點擔心舞蹈員踩到受傷

42.nps_why: Love how the philosophy of painting has been brought out by the dance, so that two dimensional visual images have been turned into three dimensional moving spirits. The forms presented by the dancers echo elements of the painting and the spacial shift of the stage is really fascinating!
42.comment: Love the live Erhu (actually was it Altro Erhu?) and viola too!
